newsitem.title: USA: Infinity says natural gas reserves up.
newsitem.headline: Infinity says natural gas reserves up.

text.p: Infinity Inc has increased reported natural gas reserves by more than 700 percent from last year, the company cited a third party reserve report as saying Tuesday.

The report by Fairchild, Ancell & Wells Inc shows gross proved gas reserves of more than 44 billion cubic feet on about 7,000 acres of the company's 24,000-acre Raton Basin properties, the company said.
Infinity shares were up 5/32 to 2-15/32 Tuesday.
